title: CARE: Conversational Affective Response Retrieval for Internet Memes
abstract: arXiv:2611.23005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational meme retrieval supports response selection in online communication, where relevance depends on both contextual meaning and affective expression. We study this task using two language-specific collections from Douban and Imgflip, containing 98,506 meme records across 5,583 discussion topics. Thread membership supplies weak relevance labels, while likes provide implicit ranking feedback. Automatically extracted sentiment, facial-expression indicators, and cross-modal consistency features support an exploratory analysis of engagement. We propose CARE, a Conversational Affective Response Retrieval framework that combines an emotion-enhanced CLIP retriever with a Jina-based reranker. The retriever incorporates free-form emotion descriptors through gated fusion and learns from multiple positive examples per query. The reranker combines query--image interactions with emotion representations and is trained using engagement-based r

translated_title: CARE：面向网络表情包的对话式情感响应检索
translated_abstract: 对话式表情包检索旨在支持在线交流中的响应选择，其相关性既取决于语境含义，也取决于情感表达。我们利用来自豆瓣和 Imgflip 的两个特定语言数据集来研究这一任务，数据集包含 5,583 个讨论话题下的 98,506 条表情包记录。会话线程中的从属关系提供了弱相关性标签，而点赞数则提供了隐式的排序反馈。自动提取的情感指标、面部表情指标以及跨模态一致性特征支持了对用户参与度的探索性分析。我们提出了 CARE——一个对话式情感响应检索框架，它将情感增强的 CLIP 检索器与基于 Jina 的重排序器相结合。检索器通过门控融合机制引入自由格式的情感描述，并从每个查询的多个正例样本中进行学习。重排序器将查询与图像的交互和情感表示相结合，并使用基于参与度的排序结果进行训练。
tldr: 提出了CARE对话式情感响应检索框架，将情感增强的CLIP检索器与基于Jina的重排序器相结合，利用情感描述、弱相关性标签和点赞参与度信号，从海量表情包中检索与对话语境和情感表达相匹配的响应表情包。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CARE, a conversational affective response retrieval framework that combines an emotion-enhanced CLIP retriever with a Jina-based reranker, leveraging emotion descriptors, weak relevance labels, and engagement-based feedback to retrieve contextually and affectively matching memes for online conversations.
